statement.p: Calculate the flux integral \int_S(2\vec i+2\vec j+2\vec k)\cdot d\vec A where S is a disk of radius 4 in the plane x+y+z=5, oriented upward.

static.solution: 2\vec i+2\vec j +2\vec k is perpendicular to S and in the same direction as the orientation, and since ||2\vec i +2\vec j+2\vec k||=\sqrt{2^2+2^2+2^2}=\sqrt{12} on S, we have \int_S(2\vec i+2\vec j +2\vec k)\cdot d\vec A =\sqrt{12}\cdot\hbox{Area of circle }=\sqrt{12}\cdot\pi 4^2 =16\pi\sqrt{12}.
